headline: SpaceX retains lobbyists ahead of US congressional probes into Starlink
summary: Elon Musk's SpaceX hired five lobbyists from Mehlman Consulting ahead of planned Democratic investigations into Starlink and Starshield restriction policies.
why: SpaceX provides global satellite internet connectivity through its Starlink constellation.

impacts.name: SpaceX
impacts.why: Retaining bipartisan lobbying firms aims to mitigate regulatory and congressional oversight risks.
